title: Floors and roofs.
officialText: In the case of a floor or roof, the standard test provides only for testing for fire expo-sure from below. Except as noted in Section 703.3, Item 5, floor or roof assemblies of wood framing shall have an upper membrane consisting of a subfloor and finished floor conforming to Table 721.6.2(4) or any other mem-brane that has a contribution to fire resistance of at least 15 minutes in Table 721.6.2(1).
